show.title: Aukaat Ka Khel
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/4t8NRc
show.description: A visionary automobile strategist, Kabir, transforms a failing company into India’s top automotive empire while silently enduring relentless humiliation from its arrogant chairperson, Naina, who treats him like a servant despite his brilliance. Bound by a three-year debt of loyalty to her father, Kabir suppresses his self-respect to fulfill his promise. On the very night the company becomes number one, he walks away with truth that power without respect is destined to fall.
